_about: Rebalance Part E: one-sided encounter rules (EncounterModifiers). Key = a dungeon foe's name, 'zone:<zone>:<enemy id>', 'town:npc:<id>', 'town:graveyard', 'arena:<id>'. Each rule: name, text (shown as the tooltip), icon (a game-icons key), side ('enemy' default or 'player'), kind + its fields - see core/dungeon/encounter_modifiers.gd for the vocabulary. The Dungeon List tab's buffs/debuffs stay in DungeonRules; these are per-encounter extras.
